expected.tolerance: information only (no measured R). Loop-only reproduction within +-3 %; the residual is unresolved (D08 does not state rho_20 or alpha_c; 0.39 is printed to two digits)

expected.kind: no D08 value (D08 publishes neither a full-phase nor a measured R)
expected.comparison: AnalysisResult.resistance_phase_20c x (1 + alpha 30 K). Its coil body (sides + end-turns, CF-10 body 158.145 mm per coil-layer) gives 0.340145 ohm at 50 degC; terminal stubs, the series chain (bus ring arcs and legs) and via barrels add to it. The chain widths (bus 1.0 mm, leg 0.6 mm) are example values (tests/unit/model/designs.py), not D08 values. The neutral ring is not in resistance_phase.
expected.tolerance: none (regression reference only; rerun the decomposition script)

cases.pre_registration: primary case A (DEF-19): N = 8, centre-lines R_i0 25.2 / R_o0 47.6 mm (reproduces 3244 mm and 171 mm2 within 0.1 %, links excluded), mu_r 1.05, 20 degC, inductance reading I1 with rotor; pre-registered alternative B: N = 7, centre-lines 20.2 / 43.8 mm (requires ~326 mm of links per phase); both are run and reported; sweeps are sensitivity runs; no tuning to measured values. EMF/torque bands are asymmetric by the EC-05 edge add-on (+5.8 % for A)
